lessonTitle: 45. Multiplying a vector by a number
lessonTitleEnglish: Multiplying a vector by a number
unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Vectors in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: ka has modulus |k| · |a| and the direction of a when k > 0, the opposite one when k < 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: ka has modulus |k| · |a| and the direction of a when k > 0, the opposite one when k < 0.

stages.headline: Properties: k(a + b) = ka + kb, (k + m)a = ka + ma, k(ma) = (km)a.
stages.headlineEnglish: Properties: k(a + b) = ka + kb, (k + m)a = ka + ma, k(ma) = (km)a.

stages.headline: If b = ka then a and b are collinear; e.g. if M is the midpoint of AB then AM = ½ AB.
stages.headlineEnglish: If b = ka then a and b are collinear; e.g. if M is the midpoint of AB then AM = ½ AB.
